_comment: Rollback artifact for the ryan-realty.com domain cutover (gate LAUNCH-16). Captures the PRE-cutover live DNS/origin state so the swap is one-step reversible. Captured 2026-05-30 via dig + curl. Re-capture the AgentFire origin target from the Cloudflare dashboard BEFORE changing any record (Cloudflare proxy hides the true origin from dig).

apex.serves: AgentFire (x-powered-by: AgentFire.com), HTTP 200, proxied via Cloudflare

preCutover.ACTION_BEFORE_CUTOVER: In the Cloudflare dashboard, open the DNS tab and RECORD the existing apex + www records exactly as configured (the proxied origin target / CNAME that points at AgentFire). Paste them into preCutover.cloudflareDashboardRecords below. dig only shows Cloudflare's edge IPs, not the AgentFire origin — you need the dashboard values to revert.
preCutover.cloudflareDashboardRecords: <<FILL IN FROM CLOUDFLARE DASHBOARD BEFORE CUTOVER>>

cutover.vercelApexInstructions: Add ryan-realty.com + www.ryan-realty.com as domains on the Vercel project, then point Cloudflare DNS at Vercel per Vercel's instructions (apex A 76.76.21.21 OR CNAME to cname.vercel-dns.com for www; set the records to DNS-only / grey-cloud as Vercel recommends so Vercel's edge + TLS are authoritative).
cutover.ttlPlan: TTL is already 300s — good. Do NOT raise it. Keep 300s through cutover so rollback propagates in minutes.

rollback.trigger: Any post-swap smoke fails (LAUNCH-01/02/06, FUNNEL-01) OR a monitor detects the apex not serving the new app / the LP 404ing / leads not reaching FUB.
steps: In Cloudflare DNS, revert the apex + www records to the values recorded in preCutover.cloudflareDashboardRecords (re-enable the orange-cloud proxy to AgentFire).
Confirm `curl -sI https://ryan-realty.com/ -A Mozilla` returns the AgentFire origin (x-powered-by: AgentFire.com).
AgentFire hosting must remain active/paid through the rollback window — do NOT cancel it until the new site is verified stable for at least 48h.
rollback.rollbackTargetStillLive: VERIFY before cutover: the AgentFire origin must still be serving so the revert has somewhere to point. As of capture, https://ryan-realty.com/ returns 200 from AgentFire.
